driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car baseline. High tau ensures cars stop at red (M3/share/car ~0). Params tuned to match discharge headway M1/car.
Car violators (custom2) drawn from 'car' distribution. Params identical to car_saval to maintain low red-running and near-zero early start.
Compliant motorcycle baseline. Reduced share (0.35) allows 'moto_seeker' to drive the observed wrong-lane and early-start metrics while maintaining overall density constraints.

Motorcycle violators drawing from the 'moto' distribution; increased share (0.65) combined with moto_saval sums to exactly 1.0 for the 'moto' distribution, boosting wrong-lane usage probability (M8/moto) and early-start frequency (M2/early/moto).
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator); share 1.0 ensures the 'moto_violator' distribution sums to exactly 1.0, retaining jmTimegapMinor for box-waiting mechanics.

traci_rules.rationale: Lowered p0/p_max to 0.1 to reduce total red-running events (M3/per_cycle) and prevent overshoot_depth inflation (M4/overshoot_depth). The high observed M3/share/moto is now primarily driven by the early_start rule rather than pure red-light running.

Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1303). Increasing p to 0.16 compensates for the lower share of moto_saval and aims to reach the weighted observed mean. Shortened t_before_green to 4s matches observation windows.

Targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (obs 0.2131) and M9a (queue blocking). q=35m triggers seeking at moderate queues. t_g_s=7s estimates green clearance. p_wrong_lane=0.25 sets a higher probability to match the observed lateral encroachment, compensating for specific trigger conditions.
Field observation: most motorcycles pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 (80% probability) and t_wait=2s reflects quick lateral filtering.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass standing U-turners; p=0.1 (10% probability) matches conservative car behaviour.
